pages.name: Chort
pages.text: A girl with white hair in a white dress. Wanders the field and appears rarely.

pages.title: White form
pages.text: Stay near her long enough and she may toss you a flower (never a Poludnytsia). But when you turn your back and walk a few blocks away, she catches up and strikes for $(thing)1 heart$().$(br2)Then she freezes. While you look at her she does not react (rarely she tosses another flower). This can go on for a long time, but she will not chase you.

pages.name: Black form
pages.text: Her look changes if you strike her.

pages.title: Black form
pages.text: Her hair and dress turn black. Now she attacks openly, and every hit inflicts $(#6A3A8A)Wither$().$(br2)$(#A33B3B)Do not strike the Chort.$() It is easier to keep looking at her and never turn your back.
